summary: Full-stack validation of Production Library v2 hierarchy + Finish Carpentry seed + Production Item Detail page + Estimate Builder integration. All 6 backend endpoints in scope PASS (6/6 pytest cases). Frontend flow verified end-to-end via Playwright: login -> Production Library (48 standards visible, matches expected) -> search 'Grab Bar' -> click FC-BA-001 -> Production Item Detail renders full metadata (desc, notes, crew=1, prod/day=12, output/hr=1.5, low=$45, standard=$58, premium=$78, trade=Finish Carpentry, cost_code=06-2000, tags=bathroom/grab-bar/accessibility, Active + Company Standard) -> Edit button enables 14 inline inputs with Save/Cancel. Sidebar counts confirmed: Company Standards=48, Knowledge Domains=19, Service Categories=11. One UI display bug found in Classification panel (raw UUIDs displayed instead of joined name/code).

ui_bugs.issue: KNOWLEDGE DOMAIN and MEASUREMENT UNIT fields display raw UUIDs (e.g. 'fd541455-6af2-4fad-983d-6115987df9ef', 'ff282669-8116-4396-a8ba-3625d2511d87') instead of the human-readable name/code. The backend GET /api/production-library/items/{id} response already includes `knowledge_domains: {id, name, code}` and `measurement_units: {id, code, name}` joins - the frontend just needs to read `item.knowledge_domains.name` and `item.measurement_units.code` instead of the *_id fields.

integration_issues.issue: Two `TypeError: Failed to fetch` console errors observed immediately after login when navigating from /app/command-center to /app/production-library ('[useOrganization] Error: TypeError: Failed to fetch' and '[AppLayout] Workspace context error'). The page still recovers and renders correctly, but these are noise-level errors likely caused by a transient double-fire on route change. Non-blocking.

action_items: MEDIUM: In ProductionItemDetail.jsx Classification panel, replace `item.knowledge_domain_id` render with `item.knowledge_domains?.name` and `item.measurement_unit_id` with `item.measurement_units?.code` (or `.name`). The joined objects are already returned by the API.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductionItemDetail.jsx renders raw UUID strings in the Classification section - should join through knowledge_domains.name / measurement_units.code (data is already in the payload).
routes/production_library.py is still 1918 lines and mixes domains / items / assemblies / import in one module - previously flagged, still worth splitting.

JWT is decoded with `options={'verify_signature': False}` across all production_library, production_library_hierarchy, production_library_seed routes. Security concern noted in earlier iterations, still not addressed.
verify_token_and_get_org() is duplicated verbatim across 3 route files (production_library.py, production_library_hierarchy.py, production_library_seed.py). Extract to a shared auth helper.
get_service_headers() is also duplicated across the same 3 files.
seed/finish-carpentry endpoint returns HTTP 200 even when items_created=0 (all skipped) - correct idempotent behavior; consider surfacing an explicit `already_seeded: true` flag for clarity.
seed/v2 hierarchy is idempotent by checking `if not divisions_check.json()` etc - won't top up if new items are added to the seed list later. Consider upsert-by-code.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% - all critical flows work; one UI display bug (Classification UUIDs)
